title: Kissed Floral Croatian Reblochon Skillet
description: A dense, floral one-pan dinner that blends melted reblochon, air-fried zucchini and eggplant, and fresh herbs for a hearty weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 200°C and lightly coat the basket with olive oil.
Toss zucchini and eggplant slices with minced garlic, chopped rosemary, salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil, then arrange them in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Air fry the vegetables for 12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until they are golden and tender.
While the veggies are cooking, warm a 10-inch cast iron skillet over medium heat and deglaze with a splash of white wine.
Evenly spread the pre-cooked vegetables in the skillet and lay the reblochon slices on top, allowing the cheese to melt into the warm vegetables.
Cover the skillet briefly to help the cheese melt, then uncover and stir to combine the melted cheese with the veggies, forming a dense, creamy mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated air fryer set at 180°C for an additional 5 minutes to crisp the top layer and fuse the flavors.
Remove from the air fryer, sprinkle fresh basil leaves over the dish, and serve hot as a hearty weeknight dinner.
